scope: All 143 frames in six contact sheets; seven fixed full-resolution dual-view pairs also inspected. Every frame independently covered by automatic numeric and pixel checks.
observed: Milk approach, gripper enclosure, lift, transport and placement in basket correspond at the same frame indices in both cameras. Distractor can tipping and occlusion sequence also correspond. No visible event-time offset or object/camera displacement beyond the frozen numeric/image tolerance was identified.
limitations: Thumbnail inspection cannot certify subpixel geometry, exact contacts or original solver state. Replayed states remain reconstructed candidates, not author-saved states. Slight texture/shading and edge differences retained. This admits this one reconstructed trajectory under the frozen criteria, not the suite or whole dataset.
